Market today: Tech sentiment is shaky, with bond yields a growing concern. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially leveraged names, feels this pressure acutely.

Your holdings: SOXL (-36.59%) and SPAL (-24.14%) are flagged for attention. They are leveraged ETFs and are currently underperforming significantly.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment and how bond yields are trending.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting your capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its significant loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF due to its current drawdown.
